technical_requirements: Target QPS: sustained 1,200 req/s during business hours; 3,000 req/s peak (burst)
Latency SLOs: p50 < 30ms, p95 < 120ms, p99 < 250ms for chat completions (<= 512 tokens)
Throughput SLA: 99.5% of requests served within SLOs when reserved capacity available
Model preference: Llama2-70B/quantized variant for lowest cost; fallbacks to 30B if capacity constrained
KV cache reuse required for conversational flows; persistent cache across requests
Encryption: keys in customer KMS; audit logs forwarded to SIEM
poc_plan: Week 0: environment provisioning (reserved pool: 8xA100-equivalent GPUs in VPC)
Week 1: synthetic load tests - ramp to sustained 1.2k QPS, 3k peak; measure latency curves
Week 2: 14-day soak test under mixed workload (chat + reranking + embeddings), simulate business day spikes
Representative prompt set: 10k anonymized production queries (sanitized), 2k personalization contexts
Acceptance criteria: p95 < 120ms and GPU utilization steady without queueing; failover to fallback model within 200ms
Monitoring: token-level cost, per-route latency, GPU utilization, batch sizes, KV hit rate
recent_findings: Initial synthetic run (2026-02-18): achieved 1.3k sustained QPS on 6 GPUs but p99 spikes at ~420ms
Observed that larger batch sizes reduce cost but increase tail latency; need workload-aware batching override
KV cache hit rate 78% on default config; caching tuning expected to lower p99 by ~30%
Autoscaling policy needs to be conservative for predictable throughput during scheduled trading events
